about_the_game:
Discover a New Dimension of the Classic Puzzle!

Dive into the world of modern sudoku with SudokuNexus Demo – a dynamic take on the timeless game, enriched with three unique game modes that will put your logical thinking skills to the test.

Available Modes in the Demo:

🧩 Standard – Classic Sudoku with a Modern Touch

The well-known and beloved sudoku variant – no time pressure, just clean visuals and responsive controls. Perfect for players who enjoy a calm and precise number-placing experience.

⏱️ Time Attack – Pressure, Points, and a Ticking Clock

Sudoku has never been this intense. Start with limited time, but every correctly placed number adds extra seconds to your timer. Keep the pace, rack up points, and don’t let the countdown hit zero!

⚡Brainstorm – Pure Chaos with Disappearing Numbers

Same rules as Time Attack, but with an extra challenge: random numbers on the board may vanish during play! Act fast and rely on your memory before the puzzle starts fighting back. This mode is for the most focused and mentally resilient players only.
